about: Hand-written layout of one of the two packs of scene.road-river (F-10; ux/scenes/homeward-road.md 1): plan metres, +x = towards Syracuse = azimuth 90° (east), +y = upstream (north), the landing ground at z = 0. Rotation 0, so glTF x = plan x and glTF z = -plan y. The two packs share places, exits and spot names (assets/pipeline/road/merge_river.mjs checks they agree and writes assets/scenes/road-river/scene.json for the backend). Spots marked auto: false are for set pieces only; way.* are the ways out. select: the page loads this pack in that act (road-river/index.json); bridge is var.bridge there, for reference. Act 2, about 05:10, dawn: the bridge stands, the water is low and still under a layer of mist (1.5).

water.about: plan coordinates (layout.json); the page turns them into glTF. channelPlan: the channel's centre line [x, y] and half width at the calm water's level, every 5 m (build_road_river.py: P_MAIN / P_SHALLOW, wiggle, meander): the mist lies over it; horizonDeg, bankM: how high the hills round the valley stand seen from the water, and the banks over it (what the water mirrors low down, not the bright sky behind them)

walkable.name: east bank down to the water's edge (the upstream shallows, y 7..18.5, are water: from x = 12 there)

the road back west, to the neighbouring village
